verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents DKIM/SPF sending-domain authentication, DMARC policy support, and DKIM DNS record setup for custom domains. A community report confirms a DNS validation dashboard exists, though it flagged problems without details, and the official MCP server can 'manage domains, troubleshoot DNS'. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Mailgun generates the exact SPF/DKIM/DMARC record values, a documented REST API endpoint exposing per-record verification status, end-to-end DMARC record generation, and corroboration that validation diagnostics are actionable.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate my sending domain end to end — the product generates the exact SPF/DKIM/DMARC DNS records, verifies them, and exposes verification status via the API
